Veterans' Canteen Service appears in §301(c)(6) but not as a named item in the 22-directory subsection; clarify contemporary presence, placement, and legal identity.
Board of Contract Appeals is named in §301(c)(7) but absent from the bounded webpage subsection; analyze contract appeals statutory transfer/successor and as-of legal status.
Sections 301(c)(8) and (9) are open statutory classes; neither supplies a finite agency denominator.
VA OIG staff-office listing does not override the Inspector General Act's statutory independence and agency-specific restrictions.
Board of Veterans' Appeals item is separately subject to 38 U.S.C. Chapter 71 adjudicative/appeal jurisdiction, not directory-proven management command.
Office of Employment Discrimination Complaint Adjudication listed as staff office but its adjudicative status and governing charter require primary-source verification.
VA Functional Organization Manual Vol 1 (March 2025) describes Administrations, distinct from February 2026 directory; versioned XML/PDF evidence and chapter-level reconciliation pending.
